verdict.rationale: Base44 has an app editor where you refine your app (base44-docs-15), and the AI shows design-option previews before applying changes (base44-docs-14). That implies some preview during building. Nothing explicitly documents a live, interactive preview of the running app before publishing; the testing agent (base44-docs-44) simulates interactions automatically rather than letting the founder use the app. Missing for 10: explicit docs of an interactive live preview pane in the editor, a clear draft/preview vs. published distinction, and independent hands-on corroboration.
